text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

The all-male panel alone proves little — economics faculties skew male, so a 4/4 panel can arise by chance. It is context, not evidence.

Your stronger facts are concrete: a completed PhD vs. an unfinished one, six papers vs. two, four years of teaching — and a two-week silence on a written explanation you're likely entitled to.

So lead with those. Chase the written reasons, in writing, citing the university's own procedures and any applicable deadline. Ask specifically how "industry experience" was weighted and whether that was stated in the advertised criteria. If it wasn't, that's your real issue.

Mention panel composition only as background once you have the reasoning in hand — not as your opening argument.
